conceptZh: 帥氣的小老鼠忍者努力忍住噴嚏，鼓起的臉頰最後只吹出一小口氣，卻把大羽毛吹得翻跟斗。
object: A cartoon mouse ninja, an oversized feather, and a solid indigo 忍 sculpture.
morph: Keep 忍 fully formed throughout: an accurately shaped 刃 above 心, with every dot and hook clearly separated. Animate the mouse and feather around the stationary glyph.
creativeAngle: 以忍住噴嚏取代變字表演：小老鼠越努力維持帥氣，臉頰越鼓，最後微小的氣流竟讓大羽毛翻跟斗；字形全程穩定清楚。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D toy animation with a warm, silly physical gag. A single correctly formed Traditional Chinese 忍 stands centered as a flat-fronted, saturated indigo sculpture against a light peach background, occupying about 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. Use standard textbook glyph proportions: clearly readable 刃 above 心, preserving every stroke, dot, hook, and gap. Keep the camera locked, the glyph stationary, and its face unobstructed throughout. Beside its lower-right edge stands a tiny cartoon mouse ninja with a teal cloth hood, rounded toy paws, and a confidently posed curled tail. At the opening, the mouse holds a perfectly serious training pose. From 0.8 to 2.3 seconds, a feather larger than the mouse drifts down and brushes its nose. The mouse tries to hold back a sneeze: nose twitching, paws pressed together, cheeks slowly ballooning while its determined eyes stay focused. Pause briefly in this exaggerated pose. At 3.3 seconds, its cheeks release one tiny, soft puff; absurdly, the enormous feather tumbles upward in three slow somersaults while the mouse barely moves. By 4.4 seconds, the feather has floated out of frame and the mouse has recovered its cool pose beside the glyph. Hold this clean, completely still composition from 4.5 through 8.0 seconds. Use soft toy materials, gentle shadows, and bright restrained colors. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, delivering exactly 「忍、忍、忍住」, with ㄖㄣˇ for 忍. Say the first 忍 around 0.4 seconds, the second around 1.7 seconds, and 忍住 around 5.5 seconds during the finished hold, with natural pauses. Stop speaking after the word. Keep the puff quiet and separate from the voice; use no music. The only visible writing is the single 忍, with no subtitles, vocabulary text, watermark, clutter, or flashing effects.
direction: 超愛又帥氣的小老鼠忍者

conceptZh: 小海盜遇上不聽指揮的鸚鵡，氣得想跺腳，最後深呼吸，忍住脾氣。
object: An original barrel-shaped toy pirate with a stubborn toy parrot.
morph: Keep 忍 fully formed as a stationary, flat-fronted sculpture: an accurately proportioned 刃 above 心, with distinct dots, hooks, and open gaps. The pirate demonstrates restraint beside it without touching or covering its strokes.
creativeAngle: 把忍住噴嚏改成忍住脾氣：海盜要求敬禮，鸚鵡卻把他的手往下壓，連整個海盜都縮進桶形身體。海盜重新探頭，忍住跺腳，讓小小鸚鵡神氣地當船長。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D toy animation with a locked, front-facing camera. A single correctly formed Traditional Chinese 忍 is centered against a light apricot background, filling approximately 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. Render its strokes in saturated dark teal with a flat, clearly readable front face: standard textbook 刃 above 心, preserving every dot, hook, and gap. Keep this complete glyph stationary, uncropped, and unobstructed throughout.

In the clear lower-left margin stands an original, unmistakably molded toy pirate with a barrel-shaped torso, telescoping toy joints, a plain plum-colored pirate hat, and an extravagantly curled molded mustache. A tiny coral-colored toy parrot sits on his hat; this stubborn bird is the only supporting character. Their silhouettes remain separate from the glyph. Use bright restrained colors, rounded toy materials, and soft shadows.

At 0.0–1.2 seconds, the proudly upright pirate gives a crisp salute, then points expectantly toward the parrot. The bird folds its wings and deliberately turns its beak away. At 1.2–2.3 seconds, the pirate repeats his salute with exaggerated importance and raises one foot, ready to stamp impatiently. The parrot slowly looks down at his raised hand. At 2.3–3.5 seconds, the tiny bird presses that hand downward with one foot: absurdly, the pirate's telescoping body retracts into his barrel torso, leaving only his eyes, mustache, and hat peeking above the rim. The parrot rides the hat down without losing its dignified pose. Add one soft wooden click, with no impact or distress. At 3.5–4.7 seconds, the pirate slowly extends back upright, puffs his cheeks in frustration, then visibly exhales and gently sets his raised foot down without stamping. His eyebrows soften into an accepting smile. The parrot gives a grand captain's salute on top of his hat. Freeze this resolved pose and the fully readable glyph from 4.7 through 8.0 seconds, providing a clear 3.3-second final hold.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「忍、忍、忍住」. Pronounce 忍 as ㄖㄣˇ, with the first utterance around 0.3 seconds, the second around 1.4 seconds, and 忍住 around 5.5 seconds while the finished glyph remains clearly visible. Use natural pauses and stop after the word. All character acting is silent; no extra speech or music. The only visible writing is the single 忍. Keep the scene free of subtitles, vocabulary text, logos, watermarks, clutter, and flashing effects.
